query: UPDATE ai_requests SET status=$4, accounting_failed_at=COALESCE(accounting_failed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), accounting_error=COALESCE(accounting_error,$3), error_message=COALESCE(accounting_error,$3), updated_at=CASE WHEN accounting_failed_at IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE updated_at END WHERE id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND (accounting_error IS NULL OR accounting_error=$3)
